title: docs/guides/heron-implementation.md and layout-aware-ocr-results.md are task completion reports
description:
**Problem**
Two guides read as agent task-completion reports, not user documentation.

**Evidence**
- docs/guides/heron-implementation.md:1 title is "Heron Layout Detection Implementation - COMPLETE".
- docs/guides/layout-aware-ocr-results.md has the same "COMPLETE" report style (checkmark status headings).

**Fix**
Rewrite both as guides (purpose, setup, usage, limits), dropping completion banners and status checklists.

**How to verify**
`grep -n 'COMPLETE' docs/guides/heron-implementation.md docs/guides/layout-aware-ocr-results.md` returns nothing and the pages read as how-to guides.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
